name: @lightdash-tools/mcp
description: MCP server for Lightdash semantic-layer, organization-audit, content-reader, content-developer, content-governance, and ai-agent-ops personas.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && for p in semantic-layer organization-audit content-reader content-developer content-governance ai-agent-ops; do mkdir -p dist/personas/$p/v1/resources/playbooks && cp -R src/personas/$p/v1/resources/playbooks/. dist/personas/$p/v1/resources/playbooks/; done
